items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: you want people to say that sounds just like Joe Smith.

ctx.x: Transcribing them and playing the licks. And I said, “Now John,” I said, “there is” and I said, “I appreciate what you’re doing, you’re doing a lot of this that I couldn’t do” you know,” but I said, “you’ve got to play like you eventually. You’ve got to take all these licks that you’ve heard different guys do and all, especially on trombone, which has no keys, so you’re really at the mercy of doing a lot of tricks with your lips, with the [scats] doodle tonguing and double tonguing and stuff like that. And I do…
Oh yeah, I can’t come up with his name, the west coast. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
